title: Cloud City: PCA Exam Strategy: Keyword Elimination & Domain Mastery

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Apprentices were memorizing the weights of bricks without understanding how arches distribute load, failing when asked to build bridges.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Grand Master Marcus reformed the Master Builder Exam: presenting real-world city crises and testing judgment under strict time limits.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Candidates learned to spot trick questions: when asked for the fastest bridge, the answer was a pontoon bridge, not a five-year stone arch.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Apprentice exams test rote memory; Cloud Architect exams test strategic trade-off judgment under enterprise constraints.
